text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Ritto Dorm Special Recreation!
The "Three-Star Carrot Cake" Treasure Hunt Tournament~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple!
Find the single cake ticket hidden inside the dorm,
and the pair holding it when time runs out wins!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Deepen your bonds with your roommate
and do your best to get it♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ready then—on your mark, get set, go!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —Or so she said, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Finding it looks pretty tough, doesn't it~.
Fighting over it with someone sounds rough too~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That cake is super popular, after all.
...So for us, let's do our best not to fight! How about that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Agreed~.
Well then, let's just sit down until time's up—
(RUSTLE—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Eh!?
Mirako-senpai, could that possibly be...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eh, yeah. The 'Three-Star Carrot Cake Ticket'...
...Wait, no way, isn't this way too miraculous?!
Hold it right thereee!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Halt. And hand over that ticket.
Right this instant.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you hold on too!!
That is far too blunt!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... By ticket, you mean
this 'Three-Star Cake Ticket', right?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*! ...Indeed!
However, we do not ask for it for free.
Following chivalry, let us duel fair and square—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, no, go right ahead, take it. We'll totally let you have it, you know?
In fact, please take it off our hands.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: WHAT?!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—Yahoo! Cake ticket acquired!
—...No! That violates the code of chivalry, so we must duel!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—A duel? Makes no sense. Are you single-celled?
—Why don't you learn the concept of restraint?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...It seems before facing Dantsu-san and her partner,
I ought to duel you first.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. Bring it on.
I will teach you just how un-straightforward restraint truly is.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Mirako
text_block_list.text: Eeehh?! She left?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is getting troublesome already, isn't it?
Let's just hurry up and pass it to someone else...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: R-Right... Anyone~! Does anyone want a cake coupon~?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What?! Giving away a cake coupon, you say?!
—No, wait. Jumping on this might be rash...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... This is likely an ingenious trap.
Surely the real thing is hidden elsewhere...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! Look, look! Nothing is coming out, see? Look~?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm. Contrary to appearances, Mirako isn't actually that greedy for food.
In that case, this might truly not be a trap, but actually...

text_block_list.name: Ending Signal
text_block_list.text: (—Clang-clang-clang-clang-clang-clang!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —And so! The ones who won the "Three-Star Carrot Cake" are the Hishi Miracle and Dantsu pair! Congratulations~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Mirako
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you~.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I-I should have just honestly taken it back then...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Guh... I blew it~! That momentary hesitation in judgment was... Gununu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Mirako
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Mirako-senpai.
...Hey, Dantsu-chan.
One day, upon arriving at the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: What is this cake?! M-My tongue is melting~~~~♡

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To think it's not just straight lines, but the flavor is delicious as well.
The whoa-level is three stars too. Whoaaa!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Sharing it with everyone was definitely the right choice after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. It would've been way too sinful to hoard this taste all to ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Mirako
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad we didn't have to fight over it~.
choice_data_list: (Those two kind of share a similar vibe~)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Thanks to you two, the bonds throughout the entire dorm—beyond just roommates—have deepened!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's all thanks to your event, Fuji-senpai!
...Always, truly!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still, I feel like finding that ticket used up a lifetime's worth of my miracles~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Fufu. If that's the case, next time I'll share some of my miracles with you!
